text:
Avery (People Ops): Heads-up: we finalized a small set of benefits & handbook edits (PTO accruals, parental leave eligibility wording, and the updated flexible work guidance). These go live next Monday. We're running two 30m office-hours sessions this Wed to walk through clarifications and manager talking points. Also: a short mandatory micro-training bundle must be completed by May 9. Please RSVP in the tracker and drop any quick Qs here.

Sam (HR Manager): Can you paste a 2-line summary of the policy changes for managers?

Avery (People Ops): Sure — TL;DR: 1) PTO accrual cap removed for tenured ICs (see section 3.2), 2) parental leave eligibility clarified for part-time hires (section 4.1), 3) formal process added for flexible work requests. Full diff + manager notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/handbook/benefits-update and RSVP sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1X-Tracker

Nina (Legal): Reviewed the language — I made a tiny wording tweak on eligibility to avoid ambiguity around start-date vs. hire-date. Added a sentence to manager notes. Recommend we include the legal Q&A snippet in the Friday all-hands pre-read.

Marcus (Eng Manager): I'll push to my leads. Which of the micro-trainings are mandatory?

Avery (People Ops): Two 15-min modules: "Benefits & Eligibility" and "Harassment & Respectful Workplaces" + a 10-min quiz. Course links in the sheet under "Training link". Internal LMS: https://learn.redwood.ai/courses/comply-2026

Jen (People Ops): RSVP'd for Wed 9:00am session. Added a note requesting a short slide deck for managers.

Marcus (Eng Manager): I'll take the 2:30pm slot if still open.

Sam (HR Manager): Do managers need to confirm completion for direct reports?

Avery (People Ops): Yes — completion flags will appear in the tracker. Managers should follow up after May 9 for any incompletes. We will auto-cc people managers in the reminder email.

reminder-bot: Scheduled reminder created: Employees without completion will get automated nudges at 7 days and 2 days before the May 9 deadline.

Jen (People Ops): Quick note — added a manager script under column "Talking points" in the sheet.

Marcus (Eng Manager): Awesome. Can we get an FAQ for PTO edge cases? Some of my team are part-time contractors converting next quarter.

Nina (Legal): I'll draft an FAQ blurb for contractor conversions and share it in the sheet today.

Avery (People Ops): Thanks — I'll update the confluence page and send an org-wide note on Friday with links and the session schedule. If you want to slot any 1:1 manager syncs, reply here or add to column "1:1 requests" in the tracker. :thumbsup:

Sam (HR Manager): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up on manager acknowledgements next week.

Avery (People Ops): Last call: office hours Wed 9:00am and 2:30pm — 30m each. RSVP in the sheet if attending or if you want a manager walkthrough. Reminder: training due May 9.

reminder-bot: Automated reminder sent to 124 employees with incomplete training (status: queued).
__notes: Document represents a single Slack thread. Messages are in chronological order, each prefixed by the sender's display name.
